about.heading: I engineer software across web, mobile, desktop, and machine learning.
about.paragraph1: I'm Manu Catalin-Gabriel, a Computer and Information Technology (CTI) student at ETTI Bucharest (POLITEHNICA University). I design and ship multi-platform systems — from high-performance media streaming across Android, Android TV, and desktop, to full-stack web applications and machine learning experiments.
about.paragraph2: I focus on clean architecture, local-first data pipelines, and responsive performance. Looking for software engineering roles and internships where I can contribute to high-impact production systems.
